source_video_title: BASIC PARAGLIDING EXERCISES - THEO DE BLIC's TUTORIALS
maneuver_name: 1C. Pitch Mistake — Re-Braking While Wing Pitches Aft (Risk of Stalling)

events.description: Pilot initiates symmetrical brake pull from trim
Canopy reaches maximum aft pitch angle behind pilot (pendulum back-apex)
Pilot releases brakes briskly hands-up at aft pendulum apex
Canopy passes overhead (theta = 0 deg) accelerating into the forward dive
Canopy reaches maximum forward dive angle ahead of pilot
